HELD LOCALLY since 2026-11-11 (gem-data.zip). One row per mine: capacity, output 2017-2025, mine type, coal type, reported and modelled coal-mine methane. Loaded by gem_extract.py: for surface and underground mines, the 2024 output, capacity, capacity factor and reported methane per t of coal; for the coal-mine methane controls (drainage, VAM oxidation), the reported methane per underground mine. Scope rule: Canada where three or more mines, else North America, else global (Brad 2026-11-11): every operating Canadian mine is a surface mine, so the underground values are North American (US mines; their reported methane is the US EPA GHGRP). Traps: the supplement workbooks of 2024 (in gem-data.zip) are superseded by this release; the Mine Type 'Underground & Surface' rows are left out; the reported methane year (mostly 2024) is matched to the output of that year; GEM's MC2M model estimates are kept in _other-values only. Canadian roster in _canada-stock.csv.
